scope: Read-only review of frozen unit-test design against program specification and C/H; no target code, specification, asset or legacy artifact was changed.
basis: Expectations were checked against the fixed program specification. C/H were read as an additional consistency and static-review basis. Legacy tests were read only after design freeze and did not define new expectations.

critical_points.assessment: INT_MIN/INT_MAX/UINT_MAX remain target limits.h symbols; no 32-bit replacement. Literal 11 is representable for all conforming unsigned int ranges.
Only passed non-NULL valid storage participates in preservation; both-NULL case has an empty comparison set. NULL is never dereferenced; untouched local objects are not required evidence.
-1 before input inspection or object access, -2 before state range access, -3 before reset/write. Compound cases and static review distinguish these obligations.
Each case starts from its own initial objects. Step order and local repeat iteration are explicit, with every repeated call checked. UT-ALM-016 requires non-target byte snapshots on each call.
Valid non-overlapping storage and exclusive access are caller preconditions; no invalid address, overlapping object or data race injection is required or claimed.
The tenth ON sample qualifies; regular spacing T gives 9T since first. This is not a 10T timing test and makes no inter-sample physical continuity claim.
Fill all bytes before typed assignments; initial old result fields are (1,1,7). Error comparisons snapshot sizeof objects after initialization; success requires fields only, not padding.

families.enumeration_review: 1+8*c+i yields unique 001..088 in stated dimension order; boundary examples 073 and 081 are correct.
families.expectation_review: P-04/P-05 give increment for old 0..8, event at old 9, saturation without event at old 10; all OFF and six invalid-sample signal values reset to zero.
families.reproducibility: All 88 input tuples, independent setup, expected outputs, symbolic limits and ID formula are explicit.

families.enumeration_review: 1+12*t+3*v+c yields unique 001..024; all four example IDs are correct.
families.expectation_review: Every tuple has invalid sample_valid or invalid signal_on under valid sample; P-02 yields -2 before P-03 including UINT_MAX. Both valid objects retain all saved bytes.
families.reproducibility: Other logical input is explicitly fixed at 1; all 24 tuples and per-call snapshots are specified.

families.expectation_review: P-02 accepts (1,1), (0,1), and ignores signal 2 for sample 0; P-03 then rejects 11 and UINT_MAX before reset or write; all return -3 and preserve both objects.
families.reproducibility: All 6 tuples, saved byte regions and symbolic UINT_MAX are explicit.

families.enumeration_review: Rightmost-fastest base-3 lexicographic A<B<C order is unambiguous; 000001,000003,000004,177147 examples match their words.
families.expectation_review: History-only capped terminal-A suffix H(j) is independent of SUT state and implementation. H=10 qualifies; prior H<10 gives one event; B or C resets. Each of 11 prefixes is checked.
families.reproducibility: Symbol C uses (2,0); setup is reset per series; all call IDs and ID width are defined. No arbitrary eval is needed.

static_checks.assessment: NULL branch returns before either dereference; logical input branches precede first state read; all error returns precede stores. Byte preservation alone does not establish non-reference; separate static reading is correctly specified.
C90 short circuit bypasses signal range condition when sample_valid=0; update condition short circuits to new count 0. Criterion does not claim absence of caller-side argument evaluation.

Entire fixed function contains no function calls or hardware/global references. Include supplies only types and function declaration; local macro is numeric 10U. External object symbols are supplemental evidence only.
Finite acyclic comparisons, arithmetic and stores; no loop, wait, allocation, recursion or formatting. No WCET or target compiler claim follows.

No mutable file-scope or function-static object. Writes target only passed state and out_result; temporaries are automatic. Sequential instance tests do not prove concurrent caller exclusivity, which remains a precondition.

Threshold 10 and old<10/new=10 implement first-ON-as-1 count semantics; tenth call is 9T after first at regular interval T. Specification correctly excludes elapsed-time measurement and physical inter-sample continuity.

coverage_review.assessment: Coverage records assign tests/reviews to routine obligations and explicitly assign CON-04 and memory/snapshot preconditions to caller, with PLC/G.YYYY/screen/log integration out of scope.

limitations: This review is not a dynamic C test run and grants no new case pass status.
Generated specification retains all case/family/static items as unexecuted. Static source consistency observations here are review evidence, not formal recorded item executions.
Requirement approval, target RTOS/compiler/ABI/WCET, caller integration and rendering/visual QA are outside this subtask.
Legacy aggregate execution evidence is mapped separately in legacy-map.json and is not new-case evidence.
